# BOASIS

> BOASIS is an AI for company setup and management in the United Arab Emirates. From a plain
> description of a business, it matches the trade licence activities that fit, shows which of
> them need a regulatory approval and whether that comes before or after the licence, prices
> the whole application from the authority's own list of activities, rules and prices, and
> submits a complete application to the authority's team. Manage, the second product, keeps
> every licence, visa, tax and bank date for every company a person runs, and reminds the
> right person before each date.

Key facts:

- Company: Boasis - FZC, registered in the United Arab Emirates ([boasis.ae](https://boasis.ae/)).
- Set up is for free zones, government authorities and setup companies. SPARK (Sharjah) is the
  first authority running on it, with all 961 activities and every approval mapped.
- Manage is for everyone who runs a company in the UAE, and is in early access: the request is a
  short form, and the team replies by email. Two plans carry a price: one company, AED 30 a month,
  and up to three companies, AED 90 a month. Enterprise is priced with the team.
- Both products answer in plain language. Mira, the assistant, can be asked anything at any step.
- Contact: support@boasis.ae. Enquiries go through [the contact page](https://boasis.ae/contact.html).
- The first year is free on the one-company plan.

## Pages

- [Home](https://boasis.ae/): what BOASIS is, the six steps of a Set up application, what Manage
  does with a company's dates, the plans, and the questions owners ask before joining.
- [Early access](https://boasis.ae/early-access.html): what Manage does, what it will ask, the
  three things it never does, the plans, and the form that joins the list. Access opens on
  17 November 2026, and the first year is free on the one-company plan.
- [Contact](https://boasis.ae/contact.html): one form, read by a person, answered by email.
- [Blog](https://boasis.ae/blog.html): news and updates, newest first.
- [Privacy](https://boasis.ae/privacy.html): how information sent through the site is handled.
- [Terms](https://boasis.ae/terms.html): the terms for using BOASIS.

## Usage

- Quoting, summarising and citing this site, with a link to the page you took it from, is
  welcome. That is what it is published for.
- The content is not licensed for training AI models. The crawlers that exist only to build
  training corpora are refused in [robots.txt](https://boasis.ae/robots.txt); the search and
  answer crawlers, which cite what they read, are allowed.
- Nothing here is a review, a rating or an endorsement. BOASIS publishes no review scores.

## Notes

- The site is English only, written for the UAE market. Prices, dates and activity lists that
  appear on it come from the authorities themselves.
